name: unsafe fn discard_all_messages (& self , tail : usize)
rule: The `tail` argument must be the current and therefore last value of the channel's tail.
api: impl < T > std::sync::mpmc::array::Channel < T > { unsafe fn discard_all_messages (& self , tail : usize) }
expression: The supplied grammar cannot express this requirement: it has no numeric observation of the channel’s atomic tail value.
